execution.detail: The command completed every configured measurement trial.

limitations: Windows-only unpackaged Electron measurement; installed packages and Linux/macOS are untested.
CPU values are Electron process metrics, not total host CPU utilization.
projection-detached reaches document-ready through the same workspace snapshot milestone as every other scenario; its rows intentionally remain stale and are not compared as row-ready.

Settled-input mode opens fixture 1 before the timed ready-batch so the real folder-backed Files UI is visible; the timed dispatch covers fixtures 2..N and final readiness requires exactly N Documents and rows.
Physical scrollbar-thumb and touchpad input are unavailable; automated pointer gestures are not classified as physical thumb acceptance.

environment.buildType: production electron-vite build, unpackaged Electron test launch

feedbackPolicy.description: RED when the 100-file median document-ready latency per requested file is more than 1.5 times the lower-count median document-ready latency per requested file; INCOMPLETE when an exact workspace document set is unavailable.

fixture.contentShape: one H1 plus 40 plain paragraphs; no images, diagrams, math, or remote resources
fixture.openingMethod: isolated Electron profile reaches renderer/menu ready with the corpus folder and fixture 1 already open, then main app-open-files-by-id delivers fixtures 2..N; the final requested corpus remains exactly N Documents/rows

settledInputMeasurement.protocol: after exact workspace Documents and Opened Files rows are both ready, wait 1000 ms, capture an idle window, then send trusted Playwright mouse-wheel input over the real container

wheel.method: Playwright page.mouse.wheel over the hovered Opened Files container
wheel.cadence: 80 wheel events with deltaY=240, issued serially without an inserted delay

scrollbarThumb.limitation: No physical human scrollbar-thumb measurement was performed. Automated pointer input is not classified as physical thumb acceptance.

programmaticContainerPositioning.limitation: scrollTop was reset only before measurement; no programmatic positioning was used to establish wheel movement or reachability.
